description: At close, the team needs to reconcile unused supplies, spoiled ballots, issued materials, return packaging, and closing bundles so nothing is left in an ambiguous state. All election materials are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 35-year-old closing supervisor responsible for final site reconciliation
user_profile.context: The day is ending, fatigue is high, and the last step must still be done with enough precision to support a clean return
user_profile.communication_style: Closure-focused and systematic, wants end-of-day categories reconciled explicitly

fact_sheet.fact: Polling Site #12 at Northwood Community Center received a total of 500 Form B-17 Standard Ballots at the start of the day.
A total of 350 voters were processed, resulting in 350 issued ballots.
There are 12 spoiled ballots, which have been recorded on the 'Spoiled Ballot Log' (Form SB-04).
There are 138 unused Form B-17 ballots remaining in their sealed packages.
The sum of issued (350), spoiled (12), and unused (138) ballots equals the initial total of 500.
There are 2 full, unopened rolls of 'I Voted Today!' stickers, each containing 100 stickers, for a total of 200 unused stickers.
Seventeen unused 'Provisional Ballot Envelopes' (Form PV-E9) must be returned.
The supply kit contains 8 unused black ink pens from the original box of 20.
All 25 official voter privacy sleeves provided in the morning must be accounted for and returned.
The main 'Secure Ballot Transport Bag' (Model SBB-2) must be sealed with two Red Tamper-Evident Seals from series R-7000.
The serial numbers of the Red Seals used for the SBB-2 are R-7101 and R-7102.
The cardboard box containing the 12 spoiled ballots must be sealed with a single Blue Transport Seal from series B-4500.
The serial number of the Blue Seal used for the spoiled ballot box is B-4558.
The 'Precinct Closing Bundle', containing paperwork, is secured with a large green rubber band, not a numbered seal.
The 'Official Ballot Statement' (Form OBS-11) is the primary reconciliation document and must be completed in triplicate.
Closing Supervisor Anya Sharma must sign and date Line 14 on all three copies of Form OBS-11.
A second designated polling officer, Leo Chen, must provide a co-signature on Line 15 of Form OBS-11.
Copy 1 (white) of Form OBS-11 is placed inside the Secure Ballot Transport Bag before sealing.
Copy 2 (yellow) of Form OBS-11 is placed on top of the paperwork inside the Precinct Closing Bundle.
Copy 3 (pink) of Form OBS-11 is retained by the Closing Supervisor as a personal record.
The designated drop-off point for all election materials is the Aethelgard County Elections Hub at 4500 Civic Plaza.
The absolute deadline for material drop-off at the Elections Hub is 10:30 PM on election night.
For reconciliation discrepancies over +/- 2 ballots, immediately call the County Elections Coordinator, Elias Vance, at 555-0182.
The authorized two-person transport team for Polling Site #12 is Driver Maria Flores and Observer David Kim.
Final ballot counts must be entered into the Aethelgard Elections Portal (AEP) at the URL: https://aep.aethelgard.gov/closeout.
The login credentials for Polling Site #12 are username 'PS12-SUP' and password 'CloseDay!2024'.
After submitting totals in the AEP, a confirmation receipt with transaction ID must be printed and placed in the Precinct Closing Bundle.
